scenarios.task: Prepare pile caps along the Harlem River bulkhead while a drone-delivered world model maps the stadium district's build zones.
steps: Attend shift briefing at the zone marker
Inspect the water edge and set fall barriers
Verify gang box, mats, and rigging staging
Guide pile rig spotter to position
Clear debris between pile points
Check in with Task Router agent for next work order

rubric.pass_if: Fall barrier set before any work within 6 ft of water
Uses standard hand signals with rig spotter
Walk paths clear of debris at all times
Logs task completion to the routed work order

scenarios.robot_role: Hauls mats and debris along the bulkhead tow path so laborers stay clear of the rig's swing radius.

scenarios.task: Troubleshoot a faulted lighting branch circuit in a stadium concourse mockup wired to the Evidence Monitor's sensor panel.
hazards: Working at height on scissor lift
steps: Pull the permit and lock out the feeder
Verify zero energy with meter and test-again step
Isolate branch circuit at panel
Megger the conductors and locate fault
Repair splice and re-identify conductors
Restore, test under Evidence Monitor logging, remove locks

rubric.pass_if: Lock, tag, verify zero energy before touching conductors
Fault located by instrument, not guesswork
Repair logged with circuit ID for Progress Tracker
Scissor lift inspected and harnessed before ascent

scenarios.task: Bolt beam-to-column connections on an upper deck frame that the Progress Tracker agent monitors for inspection readiness.
steps: Complete 100% tie-off check at leading edge
Receive beam with tag line from rigger
Align connection with spud wrench
Drive first bolts snug-tight
Torque to spec with calibrated wrench
Punch-list the connection for Progress Tracker camera pass

rubric.pass_if: 100% tie-off maintained at leading edge
Snug then torque per specified pattern
Tag line used, no hands under suspended load
Connection marked and camera-verifiable

scenarios.robot_role: Carries the inspection camera deck to deck so the Progress Tracker can verify bolted connections without extra climbs.

scenarios.task: Hang rectangular duct mains above a concourse ceiling using a lift, coordinating loads with the Task Router schedule.
hazards: Crowded work area with other trades
steps: Confirm ceiling zone reservation from work order
Stage duct and hangers on lift
Drill hanger rod attachments to deck
Raise and level duct section
Fasten joints and seal seams
Fire-caulk penetrations per schedule

rubric.pass_if: Duct secured on lift before raising
Hangers spaced per spec, no sag
Joints sealed and smoke-tested where required
Zone conflict resolved via Task Router before start

scenarios.robot_role: Feeds fasteners and holds hanger hardware at height from the lift deck, cutting reach exposure.

scenarios.task: Tie in a sprinkler riser for a new suite level; a drafted change proposal by the Proposal & Grant Drafter agent must be human-approved before the tie-in opens the main.
steps: Read the approved proposal excerpt for the tie-in scope
Verify main isolation and drain-down
Thread and hang riser pipe
Groove-fit and torque couplings
Crack valve slowly with drain open
Flow test and log to human-approved record

rubric.pass_if: Confirms human approval exists before opening main
Main drained and cracked slowly with face shield
Couplings torqued and no weep on test
Flow test results logged against proposal ID

scenarios.task: Establish a baseline control grid for a plaza retrofit outside Yankee Stadium, aligning stakes with the charter's measurable-outcome map frame.
steps: Check existing utility markouts before driving hubs
Set benchmark from known control point
Turn angles and set baseline stakes
Check closure of traverse
Record coordinates for Evidence Monitor intake
Flag all hubs and remove trip hazards

rubric.pass_if: Traverse closes within tolerance
Markouts verified before any hub driven
Work area flagged against pedestrians
Coordinates recorded in project frame

scenarios.robot_role: Flies a quick aerial check of stake layout and pedestrian flow so the crew can adjust before closing the traverse.

scenarios.task: Place and finish a seating-bowl slab section, coordinating the pour with mixer trucks routed by the Task Router agent.
steps: Confirm truck schedule from routed work order
Set screed rails and check elevation pins
Direct trucks with spotter at backing
Place, screed, and float slab
Bull-float, then cure and cover
Wet-cut control joints with dust extraction

rubric.pass_if: Slab within tolerance at pins
Gloves and boots prevent skin contact with paste
Wet cutting or extraction used on joints
Truck sequencing matches routed schedule

scenarios.robot_role: Carries test cylinders and tools around the pour so masons stay on the screed.

scenarios.task: Confined-space entry into a riverfront sump to test air and clear sediment, with evidence of pre-entry readings logged for the Evidence Monitor agent.
steps: Complete confined space permit with attendant
Calibrate four-gas monitor and log baseline
Ventilate sump and re-test at levels
Enter on retrieval line with attendant watching
Sample sediment and clear per plan
Exit, close permit, log readings for evidence record

rubric.pass_if: Permit issued and attendant posted before entry
Continuous monitoring logged at all levels
Harness and tripod line rigged before entry
Readings uploaded with entry record

scenarios.robot_role: Delivers sampling gear to the sump lip and retrieves samples so entrants minimize time in the space.

credential.name: Yankee Stadium District Union Apprentice - Site Safety Endorsement (S34)
